color.$description: Dark-theme Button snapshots: grey3–5 backgrounds, solid intent9–11 backgrounds, and their contrast foregrounds. Other families and roles are not mapped.

3.$description: Dark default Button background at rest, stored as a literal snapshot.

4.$description: Dark default Button background at hover, stored as a literal snapshot.

5.$description: Dark default Button background at active, stored as a literal snapshot.

9.$description: Dark primary Button background at rest, stored as a literal snapshot.

10.$description: Dark primary Button background at hover, stored as a literal snapshot.

11.$description: Dark primary Button background at active, stored as a literal snapshot.

contrast.$description: Text and icons on dark-theme solid backgrounds (steps 9–11), using the primary Button foreground.

9.$description: Dark success Button background at rest, stored as a literal snapshot.

10.$description: Dark success Button background at hover, stored as a literal snapshot.

11.$description: Dark success Button background at active, stored as a literal snapshot.

contrast.$description: Text and icons on dark-theme solid backgrounds (steps 9–11), using the success Button foreground.

9.$description: Dark warning Button rest anchor using exact legacy orange5; the modern Button's relative color only rounds to this value.

10.$description: Dark warning Button background at hover, stored as a literal snapshot.

11.$description: Dark warning Button background at active, stored as a literal snapshot.

contrast.$description: Text and icons on dark-theme solid backgrounds (steps 9–11), using the warning Button foreground.

9.$description: Dark danger Button background at rest, stored as a literal snapshot.

10.$description: Dark danger Button background at hover, stored as a literal snapshot.

11.$description: Dark danger Button background at active, stored as a literal snapshot.

contrast.$description: Text and icons on dark-theme solid backgrounds (steps 9–11), using the danger Button foreground.
